everything, including my life.|Mace Windu|''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''}} '''Mace Windu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Korun/Legends|Korun]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of legendary status who was the [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] in the days leading up to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], after which he gave the title to [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. Hailing from the world of [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]], Mace Windu served as one of the last members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] before the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Serving on the Council, Windu was often regarded as second only to the Grand Master Yoda, though Windu was eight centuries Yoda's junior. Windu's wisdom and power were considered legendary by many, as were the weight of his words. Trained as a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]], Windu was considered to be one of the best swordsmen in the history of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and had created the modern seventh form of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], [[Form VII/Legends|Vaapad]] along with fellow Jedi [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]]. He was the only practitioner of the form who did not fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Windu served the Jedi Order his entire life, training several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], including [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]] and [[Echuu Shen-Jon]]. It was Master Windu who led two hundred Jedi into combat at the Battle of Geonosis and slew the infamous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. He continued to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], often on the frontlines of fierce fighting, where he led Republic forces as a [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]]. He would distinguish himself across many battlefronts, most notably on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], though he would distinguish himself on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], [[Null/Legends|Null]], [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]] and Haruun Kal amongst others. In the final days of the war, Windu confronted and cornered [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] in a difficult [[Showdown on Coruscant|duel]], after being informed by Jedi Knight [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] that Sidious and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine were the same person. He was ultimately betrayed by Skywalker and subsequently killed by Sidious, falling to his death from the window of Sidious's office. ==Biography== ===Early life=== {{Quote|I knew I would succeed. After all, I had my wits, and the Force, and my feet.|Mace Windu, on [[Hurikane]]|}} [[File:Mace_Young.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Windu, at age 14.]] Mace Windu was originally from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]], where he was born into the [[Ghôsh Windu]] in [[72 BBY/Legends|72 BBY]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] anthropologists, who were studying the fact that all the [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]] could touch [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], asked the Windu clan if they might take a child back to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to regain the Korunnai's connection to the Force. Since his parents had already died in the jungles, Windu was given to the Jedi when he was six standard months old. Having not been old enough for his naming day within the tribe, the Order bestowed upon him a name as he entered the Academy. At a very early age, Windu learned of his unusual ability to see [[Shatterpoint/Legends|shatterpoints]] in the Force and how they would affect all of his future actions as well as the vulnerabilities of his opponents. Like all in the Order, the young Korun boy was taught by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] when he was a learner, and eventually went on to become a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to another Jedi. At one point during his apprenticeship, Windu trained under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]]. [[File:Mace_Windu_Jedi_Knight.jpg|thumb|150px|Mace Windu, as a Jedi Knight.]] By age fourteen, the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] was concerned with Windu, for even though he was at the top of his class, he still could not construct the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] that he had begun to assemble [[60 BBY/Legends|two years prior]]. He informed the Council that he wanted a true challenge in order to find the best pieces for his lightsaber. After considering this, the Council [[Mission to Hurikane|sent]] Windu on his own to the world of [[Hurikane]]. While on this mission, Windu was at first chased away by the natives that resided there, but was easily able to resist them using the Force. When he caused one of the fragile natives to shatter, he sobered, and painstakingly restored it using the Force. Learning a valuable lesson about being a Jedi, he was rewarded by the natives with a [[Color/Legends|purple-colored]] [[Hurrikaine crystal]] which he used to construct a lightsaber with a distinctive violet blade.''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'' He would alternatively use this weapon and a [[Mace Windu's blue-bladed lightsaber|blue-bladed lightsaber]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],{{FactFile|112|LIG 19-20|Mace Windu's Lightsabers}} and would temporarily exchange the latter for Jedi Master [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth's]] [[Eeth Koth's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] when the two underwent the sacred Jedi tradition of the [[Concordance of Fealty]].[[Star Wars (1998) 13|''Star Wars'' (1998) 13]] [[File:Windu_Battles_Khalid.png|thumb|left|270px|A younger Windu takes on Uda-Khalid.]] Over the next decade and a half, Windu went on many notable missions that included his first visit to his homeworld, Haruun Kal (during which he learned his native Korun language), and one where he tracked down and defeated the killer [[Uda-Khalid]].{{Tales|13|Survivors (comic story)}} During his career, Windu trained many to be Jedi, including [[Echuu Shen-Jon]], and fellow Council member [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]]. He also discovered [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] as a very young child after an incident involving the boy's parents. Windu ensured he was tested and placed in a training class, and later trained him for a time, although Jeht was never formally his Padawan.{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040729|text=Conversation in Shadow|int=Conversation in Shadow}} ===Jedi Master=== {{Quote|I created Vaapad to answer my weakness: it channels my own darkness into a weapon of the light.|Mace Windu, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]}} Prodigiously talented in the Force, Windu passed the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|trials]] early, and continued to progress through the ranks of the order by achieving the title of Jedi Master and, at the remarkably young age of twenty-eight, was appointed to the Jedi Council. The Council's invitation came after Windu's exploits during the [[Arkanian Revolution]] where he fought the cyborg [[Gorm (cyborg)|Gorm]] the Dissolver.''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' As a senior member of the Council, his lightsaber hilt would be uniquely decorated with [[Electrum/Legends|electrum]], a precious metal. He eventually rose to take the title of [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]]; making him the leader of the Council, and the second highest ranking member of the Order, behind Master Yoda.''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' [[File:FiveFamousJediContinueToFailToDetectTheSith-AotC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Windu meets with his fellow Jedi Councilors and the Supreme Chancellor.]] As well as his incredible combat abilities, Windu also possessed a rare gift. He had a unique form of Force perception which allowed him to see the shatterpoint in situations, beings and circumstances. These shatterpoints revealed points upon which other things were reliant. Shatterpoints could form links between beings, creatures, planets, or other vessels, and if destroyed or utilized, these shatterpoints could hold the key to averting disaster, sealing fate, winning battles and fulfilling the very will of the Force itself. In addition to being a legendary warrior and remarkably [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Windu possessed extensive knowledge of Jedi history and philosophy, and was known for his diplomatic abilities. Windu was the Council's primary liaison to the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]], although the Clone Wars caused him to question his firmest beliefs. In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], Jedi Initiate [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had mere weeks until he would turn thirteen and the Jedi High Council expressed doubts about his future as he did not attract the attention of any potential Jedi Masters. Despite Yoda's defense of Kenobi, Windu came to the conclusion that Kenobi was not suitable to become a Jedi. Kenobi would be conscripted into the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] on [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]], but would be selected to become the apprentice of Jedi Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]'' Later that year, Windu would also assist in the mediation of the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Conflict]].''[[Star Wars: The Stark Hyperspace War]]'' ====Jedi Temple sabotage==== {{Main|Incident at the Jedi Temple}} {{Quote|The thefts seem small for now. But a small threat can be a hint of a greater threat to come. Either from within or without, this threat is real. Take care, Qui-Gon.|Mace Windu informs Qui-Gon Jinn of the thefts|''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Uncertain Path]]''}} Sometime later, the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was [[Incident at the Jedi Temple|under attack]] by an unknown assailant who had stolen various items: student files, a sports kit, training lightsabers and a teacher's meditation robe. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] summoned Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn – without Obi-Wan Kenobi as the latter left the order to assist [[The Young]] on [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] – and asked him to investigate the matter with fellow Jedi [[Tahl]]. Later, it was revealed that [[Bruck Chun]] was the thief and that the attacker he allied with was none other than [[Xanatos]] – former and failed Padawan to Jinn from [[53 BBY/Legends|eight years before]].''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Captive Temple]]'' Soon after this, Kenobi returned to the Jedi Temple and approached the members of the Council. He pleaded his case that he should remain with the Jedi, but the masters were stern and were not so sure of Kenobi. Shortly afterwards, another act of sabotage occurred which saw a turbolift with [[Ali-Alann]] and his younglings trapped inside. [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]] rushed to find the Council while Kenobi tried to assist the trapped younglings. Windu, along with the rest of the Council, remained at the bottom of the turbolift and used the Force to prevent it from falling. When the younglings were saved, Windu acknowledged and congratulated Eerin for alerting them. However, he scolded Kenobi for his reckless behavior stressing that something could have gone wrong. After Xanatos fled and Bruck Chun killed in a duel with Obi-Wan Kenobi in the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]], Windu stated to Jinn that if he decided to pursue Xanatos, it was without the support of the Council. Meanwhile, Kenobi requested that he be expelled from the Jedi Order but was instead put on probation and allowed to remain as a Jedi. Jinn and Kenobi [[Mission to Telos (44 BBY)|faced]] Xanatos on [[Telos IV]], where the latter died. Jinn then accepted Kenobi as his Padawan once more and the probation was lifted. Sometime after the death of Xanatos, Windu and the rest of the Council received a communication from [[Vox Chun]], the father of the late Bruck Chun, who had died in the incident in the Jedi Temple. Chun asked for the details of his son's death to be relayed to him by Obi-Wan Kenobi and the Council had agreed to it. The Council summoned Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn and informed the pair of Chun's wishes. Windu told them that Chun would arrive at the Temple in two days from then.''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: Deceptions]]'' In [[42 BBY/Legends|42 BBY]], Jedi Master and former Council member [[Omo Bouri/Legends|Omo Bouri]] had died on a mission for the Jedi Order. Many, including Windu, were surprised when his former apprentice [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] refused to speak at the funeral. This prompted Windu to do so.[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] Shortly afterwards, Windu approached Tiin and encouraged him to take an apprentice of his own. Instead, Tiin refused and searched inward for his former master's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]]. ====Death of Tahl==== {{Main|Second mission to New Apsolon}} {{Quote|Tahl promised to keep in contact with the Council. She has not. It has been nearly three weeks since she left. She said she would be back in under a week.''"
"''Jedi Knights are not required to conform to a schedule. And missions reveal their own time frame. The Council members are not concerned.''"
"''But I am.|Qui-Gon Jinn and Mace Windu on Tahl's mission to New Apsolon|''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Ties That Bind]]''}} In [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]], Jedi Master Tahl informed the Council that she had received a communication from [[Alani]] and [[Eritha]] – twin daughters of the late ruler of [[New Apsolon/Legends|New Apsolon]], [[Ewane]]. Tahl said that the twins feared for their lives and believed that Ewane's friend and successor, [[Roan]], had murdered Ewane. At that moment, Qui-Gon Jinn burst into the room. Windu allowed Jinn to stay as he was on the original mission [[47 BBY/Legends|some years before]]. Once her briefing was complete, Tahl stated she would return in a few days with the twins in tow, though Jinn protested he should go along. Three weeks later, Jinn approached the Council with Obi-Wan Kenobi and stated that he feared for Tahl's safety and that he was going to New Apsolon to find her. Windu said that Jedi did not need to conform to a schedule and that the Council was not concerned about Tahl's mission, but Jinn protested and said he was going regardless of what the Council said. Windu then sternly said that if he left, he was doing it against the wishes of the Council. Sometime after, Windu received an urgent communication from Kenobi. He informed Windu that Tahl had been killed by [[Balog (Human)|someone]] within the government. This prompted Windu and Tahl's apprentice Bant Eerin to venture to the planet to meet with Kenobi and Jinn. After seeing Tahl's body lying in state, the team began analyzing the facts surrounding Tahl's death. But Jinn abruptly left on his own pursuit of Balog – Tahl's killer – for vengeance.''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Call to Vengeance]]'' Windu and both apprentices learned of this and followed clues as to Jinn's whereabouts. Eventually, Jinn returned and the team learned that Alani and Eritha were part of the [[Absolutes]] movement – a hidden criminal organization. The team eventually found the twins and Balog and placed them under arrest. They then left New Apsolon to restore its fragile government while they took Tahl's body to the Jedi Temple for a traditional funeral. Sometime after Tahl's death around [[40 BBY/Legends|40 BBY]], [[Lena Cobral]] wished to testify before the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] against the criminal Cobral family that she had married into through her late husband, [[Rutin Cobral|Rutin]], on the planet of [[Frego]].''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Only Witness]]'' The Council believed that Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi had spent enough time not going on any missions. They knew that Jinn still grieved for the loss of his friend but felt it was time for him to take a mission. Windu, along with [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and Yoda stated that Jinn and Kenobi would act as bodyguards for Cobral as she made her way to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Sometime later, Cobral and the two Jedi arrived on Coruscant. Windu greeted the three of them and Cobral eventually testified to Supreme Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Valorum]] of the actions of the criminal family, also noting the corruption of the Frego senator. In [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], the Council received a communication from the representative of [[Vorzyd IV]], who believed that neighboring planet [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]] was behind recent sabotages on the planet. Summoning Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi, Windu informed the two of the issues on Vorzyd IV and sent them there to deal with the issue.''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Threat Within]]'' ====Yinchorri Uprising==== {{Main|Yinchorri Uprising}} {{Quote|As you know, I loathe to enter into situations where a show of force is our only likely option. On the other hand, we who are sworn to protect the Republic cannot ignore the threat posed to it by the actions of the Yinchorri anymore than we can ignore what they did to Naeshahn and Ebor Taulk.|Mace Windu addresses the Jedi strike team|[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 1|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 1]]}} [[File:Mayvitch_soldier_contacting_Jedi.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Windu and the Council learn of the Yinchorri uprising.]] In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the Council received an urgent communication from a soldier on [[Mayvitch 7]] and he requested that the Jedi alert the Galactic Senate immediately of the Yinchorri [[Yinchorri Uprising|threat]]. He was killed as the message abruptly cut. After a discussion as to what to do, Windu informed the Council that he had sent Jedi [[Naeshahn]] and her apprentice [[Ebor Taulk]] to settle the matter, but their mutilated remains were dumped on Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] doorstep. [[File:WinduJediBriefing-ActsOfWar1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mace Windu briefing the Jedi on Coruscant.]] Shortly afterwards, Windu assembled a strike team with various Jedi being deployed to certain planets in the Yinchorr system to find a potential Yinchorri command base. Windu sent [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], Eeth Koth, [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]], and [[Theen Fida]] to [[Yitheeth]], [[Lilit Twoseas]], [[K'Kruhk]], Plo Koon, and [[Micah Giiett]] to [[Yibikkoror]] while he would accompany Saesee Tiin, Qui-Gon Jinn, and Obi-Wan Kenobi to [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]]. The Jedi sustained their losses in the skirmishes on the Yinchorri worlds as Lilit Twoseas and Theen Fida were killed. In the final battle on Yinchorr, Giiett sacrificed himself to save the others. That act killed him and swarms of Yinchorri. Giiett's death rippled through the Force. Windu grieved for the loss of Giiett despite Jinn's calm words.[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 4|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 4]] In the aftermath of the crisis the Council held a debate about who Giiett would be succeeded with. Both Yoda and Windu nominated [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], who was elected to succeed Giiett. ====Cloak of Darkness==== {{Dialogue|Yaddle|Tipping, the balance is.|Yoda|Tipping yes. But from troubled times to untroubled, or from bad times to worse?|Mace Windu|And what unknown hand is doing the tipping?|attr=Yaddle, Yoda and Mace Windu discuss the growing darkness|src=''[[Cloak of Deception]]''}} Later that same year, Windu learned that the terrorist [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] had attacked Chancellor Finis Valorum at the Galactic Senate and had wounded him. Qui-Gon Jinn was summoned to meet the Council because he and Adi Gallia had prevented the assailants killing Valorum. Windu had learned that [[Arwen Cohl]] had survived an [[Dorvalla Incident|incident]] at [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]] – where he and a team stole aurodium ingots from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] cruiser ''[[Revenue]]''. Windu listened to Jinn's claims that the Nebula Front did not mean to kill Valorum. Sometime later, a small team was formed [[Mission to Asmeru|to find]] a base of the Nebula Front on the world of [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]] in the Senex Sector. Jinn, along with his apprentice Obi-Wan Kenobi, accompanied Ki-Adi-Mundi, [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]], Saesee Tiin, Depa Billaba and [[Vergere]]. Unfortunately, the team faced complications when their ship was shot down. But the tide turned when they defeated the Nebula Front in their base with the aid of sent reinforcements. After the skirmish, Windu learned from Saesee Tiin and Ki-Adi-Mundi that Jinn and Kenobi had taken Cohl's ship – the [[Hawk-Bat (gunship)|''Hawk-Bat'']] to track the terrorist to [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]]. On [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], the Chancellor was holding a [[Eriadu Trade Summit|trade summit]] in light of the recent events. There, Windu learned that Cohl and the true Nebula Front leader [[Havac]] were killed and that the entire [[Trade Federation Directorate]], except for [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], had been killed by their own [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Shortly afterwards, the ingots were finally found – in [[Valorum Shipping and Transport|Valorum Shipping]]. The Council talked about the matter and deduced that Havac had set Valorum up by suggesting collusion and placing the ingots in Valorum's family business. ====Exploits==== [[File:Mace_Windu_Jedi_Council_TPM.png|thumb|right|250px|Windu on the Jedi Council in 32 BBY.]] As a Jedi Master and member of the Council, Windu stayed active, spearheading many diplomatic and peace-keeping missions, including ones to Yinchorr and [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].[[Star Wars (1998) 13|''Star Wars'' (1998) 13]] In 33 BBY, Windu also met with Chancellor Finis Valorum and advised him about how to deal with the terrorist organization known as [[The Flail]].{{WizCite|story=Shadows of Coruscant|book=Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook}} In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Windu attended a gathering hosted by Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum. Windu spoke with the Chancellor alongside Yoda and Adi Gallia while [[Jorus C'baoth]] and [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] were elsewhere speaking with various figureheads, which included [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] and Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] who in reality were the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Plagueis and Darth Sidious respectively.[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] Around this time, Windu scrawled his own comments alongside the writings of [[Sorzus Syn]], which would eventually make its way into the [[Book of Sith]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] to [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. Future Grand Master of the [[New Jedi Order]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] would estimate that the notes Windu made dated prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|battle]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' ====Jedi disappearances==== {{Dialogue|Mace Windu|However noble Anoon Bondara's intentions, we cannot have him and Assant acting without the knowledge or consent of the Council.|Yoda|Agreed we are on this matter. Send an investigator we must.|Mace Windu|Yes, but who? With the current state of affairs in the Republic Senate, all our senior members are on standby alert and may continue to be for some time.|Qui-Gon Jinn|I have a suggestion. Dispatch my Padawan. If Black Sun is involved, he will be able to sense it.|Yoda|Obi-Wan Kenobi. Potentially strong in the Force he is. A good choice he would be.|Mace Windu|We are decided then. Qui-Gon, you will explain the situation to Kenobi and send him on his way as soon as possible. There is something about all this…|Yoda|Yes no accident this was.|attr=Mace Windu, Yoda and Qui-Gon Jinn discuss the disappearance of Darsha Assant and Anoon Bondara|src=''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''}} Sometime later, the Jedi High Council dispatched Padawan [[Darsha Assant]] on her final mission before they could declare her a Jedi Knight. Assant's mission ended in failure, prompting her master, [[Anoon Bondara]], to find her in the bowels of the feared [[Crimson Corridor]]. When both Jedi were reported missing, Windu met with Yoda and Qui-Gon Jinn to discuss this turn of events. Jinn suggested that they send his apprentice, Obi-Wan Kenobi, to find the pair. Before Kenobi returned, the Chancellor contacted them and stated that the Trade Federation had launched a blockade of Naboo. Windu dispatched Jinn and Kenobi to negotiate terms with the Federation. En route to Naboo, Kenobi informed the Council that the pair were dead as he suspected [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] involvement. ====Continuing the Tradition==== {{Quote|Our purpose is to serve as the guardians of peace throughout the Republic. But we are fewer in number today, so we must strive to keep our traditions alive. We only do what is necessary for the good of the galaxy — what is right in the Force.|Mace Windu to Depa Billaba on why Jedi begin training as infants|{{Tales|13|Children of the Force (comic story)}}}} [[File:MW_ChildrenOfTheForce.png|thumb|right|300px|Master Windu finds Vianna D'Pow attempting to steal a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-Sensitive]] child.]] Around [[32 BBY]], Mace Windu was accompanying his apprentice, [[Depa Billaba]] on her first "Extraction", which was the process where Jedi brought young [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] children into the order. After leaving the infant on the enfermary in the Jedi Temple, Billaba expressed concern about the moral nature of taking children from their parents at such a young age and shared her un-easy visions of people she though were her parents. Windu explained to his apprentice that the Jedi order simply couldn't risk training the youth from anything other than infancy, as if they started in adolescence the child would already have too many conflicting emotions, which would be a path to the Dark Side. Shortly after leaving the room, the enfermary was broken into by the Bounty Hunter Vianna D'Pow, who took one of the children and tried to run away, unfortunately for her, the Jedi Master was still standing behind the door, and she found no other option than trying to forcefully escape, Windu expressed disgust for the Bounty Hunter as stealing children for the black market was a completely new low, eventually Vianna ended up shooting at one of the medical droids in the facility and awoke all the other babies, which Mace complained it took a lot of work to even get them to sleep in the first place. D'Pow fired another shot at the Jedi Master but he was able to dodge it due to his [[Force speed/Legends|increased speed]], Mace disarmed Vianna and demanded to know what criminal cartel had hired her, to his surprise, D'Pow revealed that the employer was no gangster but children's own parents, who had gone behind the Jedi's back and hired a Bounty Hunter to retrieve their son. Windu tried to argue that what they wanted was impossible as the infant's training had already begun and how besides, it was an honor to be taken into the jedi order. Vianna however cuted him off and openly questioned the Jedis's way of life and how they couldn't realize there were more important things in the galaxy outside of their own order. She tried to retrieve her gun but ended up picking up a datapad instead, Windu then showed her a message which convinced her to give back the child. Windu later went unnoticed and left the child at the doorstep of his family, deleting his's parents last message from his datapad. ====Invasion of Naboo==== {{Quote|There's no doubt the mysterious warrior was a Sith."
"Hmm, always two, there are. No more, no less. A master and an apprentice."
"But which was destroyed: the master or the apprentice?|Mace Windu and Yoda on the Sith's return|audio=AlwaysTwoThereAre-TPM.flac|}} When Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi had returned from Naboo, the Council learned that negotiations with the Federation had failed before they had begun and that they had saved Queen Amidala and some of her soldiers in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] before fleeing the system. Master Jinn mentioned that prior to their departure from the outskirts of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], he was [[Duel on Tatooine/Legends|attacked]] by a [[Darth Maul/Legends|dark assassin]] wielding a red lightsaber. He claimed that it was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Ki-Adi-Mundi said that the Sith had been extinct for a [[1000 BBY/Legends|millennium]], and Windu said that the Sith could not have returned without the Jedi being aware of it. Yoda stated that the dark side was hard to see. Windu said that they would use all their resources to confirm the identity of the attacker. [[File:High_Council_Chamber.png|thumb|left|250px|Anakin being tested by the Jedi Council.]] Jinn also mentioned in his debriefing that, while stopping for repairs on Tatooine, he had encountered a nine year-old slave called [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Jinn professed his belief that the boy was the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]] of Jedi prophecy as his midi-chlorian count was unprecedented. Jinn requested that the boy be trained, and Windu asked that Skywalker be bought before them. When Skywalker arrived, he was tested on his abilities in the Force. The Council noticed his strong connection, but after a vote, they decided not to train him because he was too old and his future was clouded. Following Master Jinn's report to the Jedi Council about the Invasion of Naboo and the presentation of Anakin Skywalker, Windu conducted a training duel with Jinn's Padawan, Kenobi. Kenobi successfully proved his skills by beating the Jedi Master.[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']] That night, the Council told Jinn of this, and the Jedi Master was frustrated with their decision and attempted to override it. With the matter dropped, Windu revealed that the Senate was [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|voting for a new Chancellor]] and assigned Jinn and Kenobi to escort the Queen back to Naboo and to discover the identity of the dark warrior. Sometime later, the Council had learned that Qui-Gon Jinn had been killed by that same Sith Lord in a [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle]] in Theed. Windu, along with the rest of the Council excluding [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]], [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]] and Yaddle, ventured to Naboo to attend the victory celebrations and Jinn's [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|funeral]]. The Council decided to honor Jinn's final wish and allowed for newly-appointed Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi to train Skywalker as his Padawan. Windu concluded with Yoda in silence that the Sith were indeed alive. Yoda pointed that there were always [[Rule of Two/Legends|two]] Sith: a [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]. The only question Windu asked was which one of those two had been defeated. ====Malastare and Nar Shaddaa==== [[File:SWREP14.jpg|thumb|Windu and the team on Malastare]] Later that year, Windu and the Council learned that insurgents from the planet of Lannik had agreed to peace talks which would be hosted on Malastare. Windu embarked there as an emissary along with Ki-Adi-Mundi, Yaddle, Adi Gallia, [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], Eeth Koth and Plo Koon. However, on their arrival the team realizes that they are being followed. This prompts Piell and Gallia to investigate only to attack. The attackers fled when Windu and the others arrived to help the two. Later, the talks finally begin but tempers begin to flare forcing Windu to call the talks off early. Upon leaving the venue, [[Hutar Zash]] offers the team a ride, but it is all a ruse intended to assassinate them. The Jedi barely escape only to be thrust into the middle of a podrace – the [[Phoebos Memorial Run/Legends|Phoebos Memorial Run]].[[Star Wars (1998) 14|''Star Wars'' (1998) 14]] The Jedi then race to find the Prince R'cardo Sooflie IX held captive by the [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]], who unleash [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dogs]] on the team. After they are fended off, Windu set off to find those who set the dogs on them, as they came from his home world of Haruun Kal. [[File:SWREP17.jpg|thumb|left|Windu and Depa Billaba]][[Star Wars (1998) 16|''Star Wars'' (1998) 16]] On [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Windu, accompanied by his former Padawan Depa Billaba, were investigating an animal-smuggling ring. As he was surrounded by a large number of thugs, Billaba arrived to help him, and they made short work of their assailants. They eventually located the source of the smuggling, but only after fighting a number of deranged akk dogs originally from Haruun Kal.[[Star Wars (1998) 17|''Star Wars'' (1998) 17]] Windu and Billaba would eventually end up together on Haruun Kal, with tragic results [[22 BBY/Legends|ten years later]]. ====The Pulas==== In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the Jedi Order carried out an operation to transport the [[Pulas]], a [[Dark side artifact/Legends|dark side artifact]] that had been recovered from a [[Almas Sith fortress|Sith Temple]] on the planet [[Almas]], to the Jedi Temple, for safekeeping. Following the completion of the assignment, Jedi Master [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] introduced Windu to a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] that had participated in the mission.{{LivingForce|Coruscani Dawn}} ====Mission to Radnor==== Around [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], a plague broke loose on the planet of [[Radnor/Legends|Radnor]], and this prompted the Council to dispatch four Jedi teams to assist with the evacuation of those not stricken with the plague. The Council summoned Obi-Wan Kenobi, [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]], [[Soara Antana/Legends|Soara Antana]] and [[Ry-Gaul]] and their respective apprentices Anakin Skywalker, [[Ferus Olin]], [[Darra Thel-Tanis]] and [[Tru Veld/Legends|Tru Veld]] and briefed them of the mission.''[[Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice]]'' Windu stated that the Galactic Senate had dispatched several ships to assist with the evacuation. After briefing them at dawn that morning, the teams left for Radnor and soon returned after successfully quelling the plague, and a chance for a neighboring planet to invade Radnor. ====Death of Yarael Poof==== Later that year, the Council became aware that [[Ashaar Khorda]] wanted to unleash a [[Infant of Shaa|potent artifact]] on one of the Core worlds of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At dusk one evening, the Council deliberated as to what actions to take. Eeth Koth volunteered to safeguard [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Oppo Rancisis volunteered to safeguard [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] while Windu took it upon himself to watch over Coruscant. But Yarael Poof spoke up and said that he would assist Windu in the defense of Coruscant. Shortly afterwards, Windu and the Council learned that Master Poof had died saving Coruscant from Khorda, who had been killed in skirmish. In the Jedi Temple's pyre room, a [[Funeral of Yarael Poof|funeral]] was held for the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]]. Delivering the eulogy, Windu said that Poof was the best of them all.''[[Star Wars: Zam Wesell]]'' ====Liberation of Fondor==== Over their careers, Windu had many adventures alongside the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] Jedi [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]. One unpleasant mission came on the [[Moons of Aldin]].''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], Masters Windu and Fisto responded to an emergency call by Obi-Wan Kenobi to provide backup for the liberation of the Fondor system from the machinations of [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and [[Fondorian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rodd]]. The two High Council members were critical to the retaking of the [[Fondor Spaceport]]. They had been attending the dedication of a memorial to Yarael Poof on Quermia when they intercepted Kenobi's request for reinforcements.''[[Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess]]'' ====Puzzling the peace==== {{Quote|The Er'Stacians could not choose which one piece would secure a meaningful coexistence... So I left them with a thousand choices to occupy their time.|Mace Windu and Yoda on the former's [[Mission to Er'stacia|mission to]] [[Er'stacia|Er'Stacia]]|{{Tales|13|Puzzle Peace}}}} [[File:MW_PuzzlePeace.png|thumb|right|250px|Windu shortly after tearing down the "Venerable One".]] Several months prior to the Battle Of Geonosis, Mace Windu was sent by Master Yoda on a mission to the planet Er'Stacia. The habitants of the planet had been engaged in a Civil War for several years and Windu had been sent to put a stop to the conflict. The Er'Stacians had been so lost in their battle against each other, they couldn't even notice the Jedi Master's arrival. One of the soldiers even tried to shoot Windu in the head but he was able to easily deflect the blaster. After gaining the attention of both factions, he identified himself, warned them not to test his patience, and declared the conflict as finished. The clans's leader differed however, as they wouldn't stop their fighting until one of them claimed the statue of their "Exalted One". Mace Windu was baffled at the idea of so much bloodshed being waged for a simple statue, but nonetheless offered to cut it to pieces and give each clan some of them. When they couldn't decide, he offered to just cut it in two halves and when they couldn't decide on that either, one of the warriors again shot his arm, accidentally hitting the Exalted one. Despite Windu's pleas, he couldn't stop the soldiers from ripping the offender apart limb from limb, he did found out that the Er'Stacians were united at least for a moment just to rebuild their statue. However, seeing no other option to keep the peace, the Jedi Master resorted to tearing the statue to pieces and left them with a thousand choices to occupy their time. He later came back to Coruscant and informed Master Yoda of the events transpired. ===Clone Wars=== ====Prelude to war==== {{Quote|It is done then. I will take what Jedi we have left and go to Geonosis and help Obi-Wan''"
"''Visit I will these cloners on Kamino and see this army they have created for the Republic.|Mace Windu and Yoda prepare for an inevitable war|}} [[File:Jedicouncil2.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Windu and the Jedi High Council during Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker's debriefing.]] In 22 BBY, Windu and several members of the Council, including Plo Koon, Yoda and Ki-Adi-Mundi, met with Chancellor Palpatine to discuss the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|growing threat]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Windu stressed the fact that if more planets tore apart from the Republic, there would not be enough Jedi to keep the peace. Minutes later, Naboo Senator Amidala the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] arrived to meet with Palpatine. Amidala asked who could have organized the attack on her, where her cruiser was destroyed on a landing platform earlier, and Windu said that their intelligence pointed to disgruntled spice miners on the moons of Naboo. The senator asserted her belief that former Jedi Master and Confederacy [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was behind it, but Windu and Mundi asserted that Dooku was a political idealist and former Jedi and that assassination was not in his character. Soon after, Windu and the Council summoned Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and Padawan Anakin Skywalker and briefed them of Amidala's problem. The Council assigned them to protect the senator, at the suggestion of the Chancellor. Sometime after that, the Council held a session where Kenobi and Skywalker briefed the masters of their encounter with a [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|assassin]] who had attempted to kill Amidala, but had been shot to death by an [[Jango Fett/Legends|unknown armored figure]]. Yoda tasked Kenobi with finding the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and assigning Skywalker to escort Amidala to safety on Naboo. Windu tasked Skywalker with getting the Chancellor to speak to Amidala about the Jedi mission. Shortly afterwards, Windu met with Yoda and Kenobi to discuss the mission at hand. Kenobi expressed his doubts about Skywalker being alone on a mission, but Yoda said that the Council was confident in their decision. Windu then reminded Kenobi that if the prophecy was true, Skywalker was the Chosen One. Later, Windu entered Yoda's private quarters to find the Grand Master disturbed in his meditation. Settling himself onto a seat, he asked Yoda what was wrong. Yoda said that he felt pain, suffering and death and said that something terrible had happened. He also said that Skywalker was in "terrible pain." Sometime later, Windu was present in the Chancellor's office with fellow Jedi Masters Yoda, Kit Fisto, [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] and Plo Koon alongside Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] and others. Windu watched Kenobi report that he tracked the bounty hunter Jango Fett to droid foundries on Geonosis. He also reported that [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] Nute Gunray was behind the assassination attempts on Senator Amidala. He also said that the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] and the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] with other factions had pledged their armies to Count Dooku. Before he could say anything else, Kenobi was attacked by [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] and captured. ====Battle of Geonosis==== {{Main|First Battle of Geonosis/Legends}} {{Quote|This party's over.|Mace Windu, to Dooku|}} [[File:Jedi_on_Geonosis_by_Trevas.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Windu alongside Kenobi and Skywalker, battling in the Petranaki arena.]] Shortly afterwards, it became apparent that a full-fledged military conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems would occur. Kenobi was captured by the Confederacy on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and had been prepared to be executed. Windu met with Yoda at the Senate, and watched as [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] bestowed emergency powers upon Palpatine, granting him the power to use the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Having learned of this, Mace Windu, without waiting for the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] army to be put at the Republic's disposal, led a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi strike force]] to Geonosis. Windu, along with [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], destroyed Geonosian gun emplacements blocking the way to the arena in his [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130S fighter tank]]. When Kenobi, Skywalker, and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] were brought to the [[Petranaki arena|Geonosis arena]], Windu and his Jedi revealed themselves to Count Dooku, the leader of the Confederacy, who was personally overseeing the planned execution. Windu personally confronted Dooku and his bodyguard, Jango Fett, in the former's private viewing booth. At that moment, Windu viewed Dooku as the shatterpoint of the entire Separatist movement, which meant striking Dooku down would theoretically end the imminent clone war before it even began. However, Windu's prior attachments to Dooku clouded his judgment, and Windu was promptly distracted by a squad of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]] before being flung into the arena by Fett's [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]]. A heated but short battle followed, during which Windu decapitated Fett. Eventually, the Jedi were outnumbered by Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], but Master Yoda and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] rescued the Jedi. After that, Windu and the other surviving Jedi joined [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|the battle]] as military commanders. Windu again took the controls of his tank and was moving to intercept Count Dooku when three of Dooku's [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]] confronted him in their own vehicles. Windu was able to defeat all three of them, but the delay prevented him from reaching Dooku.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]] [[File:Jangodied.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mace Windu [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitates]] Jango Fett.]] Windu's failure to strike down Dooku when he had the chance haunted him for some time afterwards, since Dooku's escape effectively neutralized the Count's position as the war's shatterpoint. While many Jedi were haunted by traumatic nightmares about the Battle of Geonosis, Windu was faced with a recurring dream in which he killed Dooku before dying an honorable death at the hands of Jango Fett. As stated in his personal journals, Windu viewed his own reality of preventing the Clone Wars as his nightmare. In the aftermath of Geonosis, Windu handed the title of Master of the Order to Yoda, who held it in addition to that of Grand Master. Also, Windu spoke with Yoda and Kenobi in the Jedi High Council chamber, and he learned from Kenobi that while he was Dooku's prisoner he learned hundreds of senators were under the influence of Sith Lord, Darth Sidious. ====Ruul==== {{Main|Mission to Ruul (Clone Wars)}} Several months after Geonosis, Mace Windu was contacted by his old friend Sora Bulq, who was leading a group of renegade Jedi who protested Jedi involvement in the Clone Wars. In response to Bulq's message, Windu traveled to Bulq's estate on [[Ruul (moon)|Ruul]] to meet with them. Unfortunately, just after he arrived, Bulq was ambushed by the Dooku-trained assassin [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], resulting in the death of his Padawan. When the other Jedi, including Windu, involved themselves, Ventress claimed she had been sent by Windu himself, confusing the other Jedi.''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]'' While the other Jedi busied themselves, Windu began investigating Ventress' presence, unknowingly followed by the Jedi [[Rhad Tarn]]. During his investigations, he found Ventress' ship, and realized that Bulq must have allowed her on the planet, since no one could land on Ruul without Bulq being aware of it. Rushing off to confront Bulq, Windu found him in his estate mourning over the body of his Padawan. When Windu accused Bulq of turning to the dark side and joining the Confederacy, Bulq didn't deny it. Bulq went further and revealed that the only reason that he brought Windu here for was to exploit his hardliner reputation and discredit him, using the other Jedi as witnesses, as they were unaware of his plans. [[File:WinduvsBulq.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mace Windu versus Sora Bulq.]] Bulq then drew his lightsaber and shoto and announced his intention to now kill Windu and return to the others alone, claiming Windu betrayed them. Windu drew his own blade and the battle was on. However, as the two engaged one another in a furious duel, Mace Windu sensed that the other Jedi were in danger and swiftly ended the fight by bringing down a pile of boulders upon Bulq. Rushing to Ventress' ship, he found Rhad Tarn dead and the other Jedi who had followed Tarn engaging the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] assassin. Though Ventress briefly dueled Windu she realized she was no match for the Korun Jedi Master and was forced to flee in a [[Solar sailer/Legends|solar sailer]]. After Ventress' retreat and Bulq's exposure as a Confederate agent, Windu and the surviving Jedi returned to Coruscant. ====High Jedi General==== {{Main|Battle of Dantooine (Clone Wars)}} [[File:Mace_Windu_during_the_Battle_of_Dantooine.jpg|250px|thumb|Mace Windu using his mastery with the lightsaber to destroy the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droids]] on Dantooine.]] During the Clone Wars, Windu commanded [[Systems Army Alpha]]{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}} as a [[High Jedi General/Legends|High General]] along with the [[187th Legion/Legends|187th Legion]] on many fronts, and won a widely publicized victory at the [[Battle of Dantooine (Clone Wars)|Battle of Dantooine]].{{CW|12}}{{CW|13}} He single-handedly defeated an army of B2 super battle droids and a massive [[Seismic tank/Legends|seismic tank]], using his bare fists for much of the battle when he lost his lightsaber in the tank's initial blast. Windu later regained said lightsaber, leapt onto a part of the tank, cut his way inside, battled the droids and destroyed the tank from within. ====Haruun Kal==== {{Main|Battle of Haruun Kal/Legends}} {{Quote|We don't have to win, we only have to fight.|Mace Windu|}} [[File:Shatterpoint-Scalf-ERC.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Nick Rostu, Chalk and Windu on Haruun Kal]] Six months after the Battle of Geonosis, Windu returned to his homeworld of Haruun Kal to track down his missing former Padawan, Depa Billaba. He was attacked twice in the capital city of Pelek Baw, but met up with a team sent by Billaba to bring him to her. While trekking through the jungle toward Billaba, he managed to defeat three [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Sienar]] Turbostorm gunships, destroying two and crippling the third, in a masterful display of the versatility and lethality of Vaapad. Windu, along with his companions [[Liane Trevval|Chalk]], [[Lesh]], [[Besh (Korun)|Besh]], and [[Nick Rostu]], were frequently in danger from the numerous hazards of the jungle and militia attacks. Throughout his stay on Haruun Kal, Windu was often attacked, beaten, and injured by a variety of opponents. After meeting up with Depa, Windu resolved to bring her back to the Jedi Temple. He also had to deal with the powerful ''[[lor pelek]]'' [[Kar Vastor]]. After the militia launched an all-out attack on the Korunnai that Billaba had been leading, he then devised a plan to capture the world for the Republic and battled Kar Vastor, spiritually facing the dark side. Windu would also duel his former Padawan after she succumbed to ''[[pelekotan]]'', and won without actually defeating her. Though Windu survived this trial and his strategy was successful, the memories of his return to Haruun Kal would continue to haunt him. Billaba later attempted suicide upon realizing her fall to the dark side, and would remain in a coma for an unknown period afterwards. [[File:MaceWindu-TCW.png|thumb|right|150px|Mace Windu during the Clone Wars.]] Mace Windu, in Force-assisted dreams on Haruun Kal, accurately predicted the fall of the Jedi and the destruction of the Temple, in addition to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] of Coruscant. ====Battle of Simocadia==== {{Main|Battle of Simocadia}} Despite the urgings of Yoda to stay far away from the planet and his own doubts about attachment, Windu made a return visit to aid his friends on [[Simocadia]] during the [[Battle of Simocadia]]. Attacked because of a rare [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] crystal that both the Republic and Separatists desired, the [[Mosciive]] people desperately needed help to keep their planet from being ravaged completely.''[[The Clone Wars: The Colossus of Destiny]]'' Beginning on his starship, Windu took an encapsulated shuttle down to Simocadia's surface, taking out several Separatist ships in the process. Landing outside the [[Royal City (Simocadia)|Royal City]], Windu and his clone brigade quickly overwhelmed the Separatist droids. Meeting with [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Sephani]], Windu learned that his old friend, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Yojan]], had defected to the Separatists in order to do what he thought best to protect his planet. Despite the resistance of the palace guard to allow the Jedi to pursue their leader's son, Windu left Sephani with rapid speed, promising to bring her son back to the Republic alive. Utilizing the prince's Separatist-allied right-hand man [[Demo]] and carefully avoiding all of the man's traps, Windu allowed him to lead the way to Yojan, where he attempted to convince him to return to the Republic. Yojan assured Windu that he had no intentions of actually switching persuasions to the Separatists - he merely wished to get close enough to Separatist voices to destroy the agrocite on the planet, leaving no temptation for any army to invade ever again. However, Windu was adamant that activating such widespread destruction would actually destroy Simocadia, and pledged to defeat Yojan for the good of the planet. The two engaged in a brief duel while Demo sneaked behind the pair and inserted the [[Ardana Shadex]] into a mechanism, activating a massive colossus that Yojan had programmed to destroy the agrocite mines. Windu, in an attempt to incapacitate the creature, sent his lightsaber into the Shadex, but ended up destroying the only link Yojan had to controlling it. With the colossus on a planet-wide rampage, Windu teamed with Yojan to pilot a gunship in a tight orbit around the creature. Windu leapt onto the hulk, grabbed the Ardana Shadex, and wounded it, causing it to open its mouth, while Yojan grabbed the Shadex, leapt inside, and stuck it in the automatic-kill slot. The beast self-destructed with Yojan stuck inside, and although Windu had saved Simocadia from massive destruction, he was recognized and shunned as being the killer of their prince. He left in disgrace, shame, and disappointment, recalling bitterly the moment he and Yojan had pledged their undying friendship and the personal toll the war was taking on his life. ====Knighting Anakin Skywalker==== {{Dialogue|Even Piell|Palpatine has been requesting this for months now.|Mace Windu|Politicians have no voice in Jedi matters.|Kit Fisto|Well, he ''is'' a cunning warrior ''and'' our best pilot.|Adi Gallia|But he is reckless with his gifts.|attr=Even Piell, Mace Windu, Kit Fisto and Adi Gallia discuss promoting Anakin Skywalker to Jedi Knight|src={{CW|21}}}} [[File:JediHighCouncilCloneWars.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Council deliberates about elevating Anakin Skywalker to the rank of Jedi Knight.]] In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|battle]] on [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]], the Council became aware of a new threat in the form of General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Windu agreed that Grievous was tipping the war in favor of the Separatists, and [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] recommended that potential Padawan learners be [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|elevated]] to the rank of Knight. Obi-Wan Kenobi suggested that they forgo the traditional Jedi Trials and promote Anakin Skywalker to the rank of Knight, and this generated much debate and uncertainty. Adi Gallia and Oppo Rancisis respectively claimed that Skywalker was reckless with his gifts, and to walk the path of the Jedi it required discipline which Skywalker lacked at times. Nevertheless, Yoda decided that Skywalker would be elevated to the rank of Knight. ====Helping a Hutt==== {{Quote|We must help Jabba. This is the opportunity we have been looking for. The Jedi must rescue Jabba's son.''"
"''I don't like it dealing with that criminal scum. This is a dark day for the Republic.|Palpatine and Mace Windu discuss the alliance with Jabba|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]}} Windu was present with Chancellor Palpatine alongside Plo Koon and Luminara Unduli when [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] sent an urgent communication. The Hutt said that his son had been kidnapped and he wanted the Jedi Order to find his son and bring him to safety. This put the Jedi in a tight spot as the Hutts possessed valuable trade routes the Jedi needed for the war. ====The Malevolence==== [[File:Ahsoka_speaks_out.png|thumb|left|230px|Tano speaks out against Chancellor Palpatine and the Jedi Council.]] After discovering that the Confederacy possessed a [[Malevolence/Legends|mysterious weapon]] in the form of a starship, the Jedi Council dispatched Plo Koon to [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|to deal]] with the weapon. Having lost contact with Koon, the Council feared the worst for him. Windu, Yoda, Kenobi and Chancellor Palpatine discussed this turn of events and Ahsoka Tano spoke out against them saying that just because no one had previously survived, it meant that Koon could still be alive. He also said that Grievous had killed Vebb, who challenged Grievous in anger and through his own power. ====Dooku captured==== {{Quote|Send your Jedi, but they must be unarmed.''"

"''Not when I hold all the cards.|Mace Windu captures Wat Tambor|audio=IHoldAllTheCards-LoR.flac|{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}}} After answering a plea from the Senate, the Jedi Council sent Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|breach]] the heavy Separatist blockade around the planet of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] so as to make way for a ground assault aimed at freeing the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] people from Separatist occupation.{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}} When the initial engagement with the blockade proved unsuccessful, resulting in huge losses on the side of the Republic, Master Windu warned Skywalker that he was allocated only a single planetary rotation of Ryloth to breach the blockade, as the invasion needed to move forward with or without having broken the Separatist's defenses. Windu told Skywalker that they would have to postpone the invasion. As such, Skywalker and Tano utilized less than conventional tactics to defeat the Separatist warships; making way for the forces led by Masters Windu and Kenobi to begin their ground assault of the oppressed planet. Kenobi and [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]] set off to land at the village of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]], which the Jedi planned on using as a landing point. Windu told Chancellor Palpatine and Senator [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] that their forces were stretched too thin for an all out attack on Lessu. To accomplish this, Windu was forced to rely on his considerable negotiation skills, as he knew he would require the aid of [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]]; leader of the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|Twi'lek freedom fighters]]. However, Syndulla loathed to negotiate with the Republic as he did not trust Ryloth's Senator Orn Free Taa, while Taa himself feared that Syndulla planned to seize power. After learning that the Separatists had begun to bomb innocent Twi'lek villages, Syndulla at least agreed to talk with Senator Taa.{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}} Windu acted as moderator during the talks, and ultimately was able to form an alliance between the two out of their mutual wish to see their people free. Syndulla then added his forces to Windu's and the pair managed to retake Lessu from Tambor. In addition, Windu managed to capture the fiendish Separatist leader himself. Windu, alongside commander Ponds, watched the victory parade in the city in satisfaction. ====Juma 9 and Behpour==== {{Main|Battle of Juma 9|Battle of Behpour}} {{Quote|He's gone.''"
"''Defeated, but not destroyed.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Mace Windu on Dooku's defeat in their duel|}} [[File:Juma_9.jpg|thumb|right|230px|The Juma 9 station]] Shortly afterwards, he was [[Battle of Juma 9|sent]] to Juma 9 in order to rescue Jedi Masters Plo Koon and Obi-Wan Kenobi with the aid of Kit Fisto and clone private [[Switch (clone trooper)|Switch]], while Commander Ponds fought on the outside of the station itself. In addition, they reported that they had encountered Asajj Ventress. During the briefing, they received an urgent communication from Senator Amidala who stated that she had discovered a massive Separatist facility on [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]] under the command of the Sith Lord Count Dooku. Unfortunately, she could say no more as she was captured. The Jedi, before breaking communication, organized an [[Battle of Behpour|attack]] on the foundry. [[File:Kenobi_and_Windu_on_Behpour.png|thumb|left|250px|Kenobi and Windu fight Dooku's MagnaGuards on Behpour.]] With Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi diverting attention to themselves in one part of the facility, Windu and Padawan Tano waited for the shields to the facility to be taken down to allow the Jedi and their forces to attack and invade the factory. Once the shields were down, Windu and Tano led the charge and struck at the facility after using AT-TE walkers to get there quicker. Once inside the facility itself, Windu and Kenobi confronted Dooku himself. After a brief conversation and eliminating his personal guards, the two dueled Dooku. Not powerful enpugh to defeat him alone, the two Jedi Masters combined their efforts and together overcame the Sith Lord. At the end of the duel, Dooku fell below the platform. Kenobi remarked he was gone but Windu said he was not dead. With that, they boarded the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] and left the facility. Soon after, Skywalker, Tano and the freed Amidala joined them. ====Stolen holocron==== {{Quote|No more of your tricks.|Mace Windu to [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]|{{TCW|Children of the Force}}}} {{Main|Mission to Black Stall Station/Legends}} Following the [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|First Battle of Felucia]], Windu was present during a meeting of the Jedi Council which heard that Padawan Tano had refused to comply with orders given to her by her superior Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi. When Windu asked if Kenobi's claims were true, Tano responded by saying that she refused his orders. As a punishment for her actions, Tano was appointed as a guard of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] in order to spend time away from the battlefield.{{TCW|Holocron Heist}} Later, Master Yoda sensed a disturbance in the Force that suggested intruders would attempt to infiltrate the Jedi Temple. As such, the entire Temple was placed on high alert. While Kenobi and Skywalker tracked the intruders through the central ventilation system, Windu monitored the situation with Master Yoda, Kit Fisto and Aayla Secura in the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Jedi Temple communication center]]. [[File:Communication_center.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mace Windu and other Jedi Masters in the Jedi Temple communication center.]] As Kenobi and Skywalker tracked the intruders through the Temple's ventilation system, Master Yoda deduced that it was likely that the intruders were receiving assistance from within the Temple considering their ability to avoid the two Jedi trailing them. As such, the diminutive Master contacted Ahsoka Tano in the Archives and cautioned her that he sensed that there was somebody in the Archives impersonating a Jedi. Fortunately, Tano was able to subdue the imposter, a Clawdite [[Changeling/Legends|changeling]] named [[Cato Parasitti/Legends|Cato Parasitti]], who had been impersonating Master [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]] and feeding her employer [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] information from the Jedi Archives. Unfortunately, Bane's scheme worked, as he was able to keep the Jedi off his tail by creating a diversion using his droid [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]]. Todo had been rigged with a bomb which was set to explode when he entered the communication center; however, Master Windu was able to use the Force to blast Todo back into the vent, saving the lives of the other Jedi present. However, in this time, Bane was able break into the [[Holocron Chamber]] and steal a Jedi [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] as ordered by the Sith Lord Darth Sidious. Unbeknownst to Bane, Parasitti revealed to the Jedi that Bane's next target was Jedi Master [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]]. This allowed the Jedi to deduce that Bane was after the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]] in Ropal's keeping, which when combined with a holocron would reveal a list of all known Force-sensitive children in the galaxy. While Skywalker and Tano were dispatched to protect Master Ropal they were ultimately too late; Ropal was captured and died under torture, refusing to use the Force to help Bane unite the holocron and Kyber crystal. However, the Jedi believed that Bane himself was killed during the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|Battle of Devaron]], though he later proved to have survived. Unfortunately, prior to faking his death Bane was able to coerce Skywalker into uniting the holocron and memory crystal giving him access to the names of the most Force-sensitive children in the Republic.{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}} [[File:Mind-trick_combined.png|thumb|left|250px|Windu, Kenobi and Skywalker interrogate Bane with the Force.]] After Bane's escape, Master Windu participated in a meditation session, along with Masters Yoda and Kenobi, and Jedi Skywalker. During this session, they used the Force to sense which children Bane would target. While Yoda sensed that children would be abducted from both Rodia and Naboo, Master Windu felt that a child on [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]] was in danger. Unfortunately, Yoda revealed that he had sensed that particular child disappear into the darkness, meaning that Bane had already captured him. While Kenobi was dispatched to protect the Rodian child and Skywalker was sent to Naboo to safeguard the Force-sensitive [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]], Windu and Yoda remained at the Temple to continue using the Force to search out those children who were in danger. Unfortunately, Kenobi arrived too late to rescue the Rodian child, [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]], however, Skywalker and his apprentice successfully protected their Gungan charge and apprehended Bane. Masters Windu and Kenobi then proceeded to interrogate Bane as to the whereabouts of the two children he had abducted, along with the Jedi holocron, however, he refused to talk; causing Windu to conclude that the bounty hunter's fear of his employer outweighed his fear of the Jedi. Windu, Kenobi and Skywalker then decided to use the Force on Bane's mind simultaneously to force him to co-operate. This interrogation method nearly destroyed the bounty hunters mind, however, it proved successful as he agreed to take the Jedi to both the children and the holocron. [[File:WinduKenobiBlackstall-COTF.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Windu during the mission to Black Stall Station.]] Chancellor Palpatine later requested a report on the situation, however, both Kenobi and Windu felt that as an internal Jedi affair, there was no need for the Chancellor to be involved. However, Skywalker disagreed, and as such, Windu had the younger Jedi be the one to report to Palpatine, while he and Kenobi [[Mission to Black Stall Station/Legends|traveled]] to [[Black Stall Station/Legends|Black Stall Station]] with Bane acting as their guide. At the station, neither Jedi Master could sense the children in the Force. Bane assured them that the children were safe and that he had brought them there to retrieve the holocron. When Windu stopped the bounty hunter from personally bringing them the holocron, and made to retrieve it himself, he accidentally set off Banes security measures. In the ensuing chaos, Bane proved able to escape, though both Jedi Masters survived the ordeal and reclaimed the holocron. Fortunately, through an examination of Bane's ship, Skywalker and Tano had discovered the location of the facility where the children were held, and managed to rescue them. Following Bane's escape, Windu took the time to attempt to console Ropal's apprentice, [[Tyzen Xebec]]. Windu urged Xebec to view his master's death as an honorable service to the Republic, but his words didn't have much of an impact on the Padawan.''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'' ====Separatist droid foundry==== [[File:GeonosisPlanning.png|thumb|right|250px|The Jedi plan their invasion of Geonosis.]] Masters Windu and Yoda later came to suspect that Senator [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] of [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]], a member of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], was tied to the Separatists. As any sign of the Jedi's suspicions would cause a major incident, the Masters felt that a member of the Senate would have to investigate him in their stead; the Council ultimately decided that the perfect candidate for the mission was Senator Amidala of Naboo, who was both a long-time ally of the Jedi and had previously been close to Clovis. Unfortunately, Amidala rebuffed Yoda's initial attempts to recruit her, as he did not specify that the Council believed Clovis to be in league with the Separatists.{{TCW|Senate Spy}} Later, under the request of the Council, Anakin Skywalker approached Amidala about the mission and inadvertently persuaded her to accept it. Amidala traveled to [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] with Clovis, and ultimately discovered that he was aiding the Separatists to create the largest droid foundry in the galaxy on Geonosis; where the Clone Wars began. The Council then [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|dispatched]] a huge force led by Jedi Masters Obi-Wan Kenobi, Ki-Adi-Mundi and Luminara Unduli to Geonosis in the hopes of destroying [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser's]] new droid foundry. Also, Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano were sent to assist the three Jedi Masters after [[Battle of Dorin|routing]] the Separatists from [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]]. Shortly before the attack on Geonosis, Windu - via hologram with Chancellor Palpatine and Yoda - went over the attack with the Jedi. It was stressed that Poggle the Lesser needed to be apprehended during the battle.{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}} ====Funeral of Onaconda Farr==== {{Main|Funeral of Onaconda Farr/Legends}} [[File:FarrFuneral.png|thumb|right|250px|Windu attends the funeral for Senator Farr]] Windu later attended the funeral of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Senator Onaconda Farr, who recently died on Coruscant in the company of fellow senators. Windu attended the service alongside Yoda and other dignitaries. After Farr's aid - [[Silood/Legends|Silood]] - delivered the eulogy and the casket was sent back to Rodia, Windu and the crowds dispersed.{{TCW|Senate Murders}} ====Zillo Beast Incident==== {{Main|Battle of Malastare/Legends|Zillo Beast incident/Legends}} [[File:Hello_beastie.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Mace Windu and his troopers encounter the Zillo Beast.]] Windu later led Republic forces during the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]] alongside Anakin Skywalker, pushing to drive Separatist forces out of the system and secure a treaty with the [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] that would grant them access to their valuable fuel. At some point during the Malastare campaign, [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]] developed an electro-proton bomb that would wipe out all electronic life but leave living organisms fully functional. They tested the technology out with outstanding results, although the resulting explosion site collapsed into a crater. Windu led the investigation squad into the crater, and was the first to discover the presence of the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]], a creature long thought to be extinct by the Dugs.{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}} Leading his troops in a quick retreat aboard a gunship, Windu organized an impromptu council with himself, Skywalker, Boll, [[Doge/Legends|Doge]] [[Nakha Urus/Legends|Nakha Urus]] and Supreme Chancellor Palpatine to discuss their options in dealing with the creature. While the Jedi were in favor of preserving the beast's innocent life, the Dugs merely wished to see the dangerous creature destroyed forever. Taking the discussion to a private area away from Urus, Palpatine suggested that concentrated stun beams should be used to incapacitate the beast, leading the Dugs to believe it dead, and then transport it somewhere in the Outer Rim for research on its lightsaber-resistant scales. Windu and Skywalker agreed with the plan, although Urus had already begun his own mission to dump toxic fuels into the beast's crater to kill it. Despite Windu's threats towards Urus, the argument between the pair was negated when the beast clambered out of the pit and began to terrorize the Republic camps. It was brought down by the stun rays and, in a last-minute switch of orders from Palpatine, transported to Coruscant for research. Windu and Skywalker followed the beast to Coruscant, where the former approached Kenobi in the hopes of starting a movement against the Supreme Chancellor and demanding the release of the creature. Although Kenobi was able to convince Skywalker and Senator Amidala to speak to Palpatine, they were too late, and the Zillo beast escaped from its constraints, making a beeline towards the Senate chambers. Windu, alongside Kenobi, Yoda, and Aayla Secura as well as Captain [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], oversaw the Republic's [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|defense]] of Coruscant against the beast, commanding stun tanks to subdue the beast. Despite Windu's best efforts, the beast was unable to be peacefully tranquilized, and it was killed by concentrated toxin-bombs.{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}} ====Boba Fett==== {{Main|Sabotage of the Endurance/Legends}} {{Quote|Whose helmet is that anyway?''"
"''It belongs to a bounty hunter I killed on Geonosis, by the name of Jango Fett.''"
"''You mean the clone template?''"
"''Yes. Strangely enough he had a son, or at least a clone he regarded as a son. His name is Boba Fett.|Anakin Skywalker and Mace Windu|{{TCW|R2 Come Home}}}} [[File:WinduSkywalkerEndurance.png|thumb|right|230px|Mace Windu and Anakin Skywalker, trapped on the ''Endurance'']] Windu and Anakin Skywalker made a visit to the [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']] later in the war, where they mentored a group of young clone cadets. Windu and Skywalker escaped the crashing ship in their starfighters and watched the flaming hulk descend to the planet Vanqor below.{{TCW|Death Trap}} During the salvage operation of the ''Endurance'', Skywalker came across a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] helmet on the bridge, which Windu soon recognized as the helmet of the late Jango Fett. Although he warned Skywalker to drop it immediately, the helmet exploded, and Windu was barely able to pull Skywalker away in time. With the ''Endurance'' collapsing around them, the two Jedi were trapped under a large piece of the ship and, unbeknownst to them, were waiting targets for the approaching Fett, Sing, and Bossk. After learning that Windu's astromech droid [[R8-B7/Legends|R8-B7]] had been destroyed by [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], Skywalker sent his own droid [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to transmit a message to the Jedi Temple, calling in help. The two Jedi returned to Vanqor with R2-D2 in tow and rescued Windu and Skywalker moments before the entire ''Endurance'' collapsed in a flaming wreck. Windu was too wounded to continue the search for Fett, and was forced to watch along the sidelines as Koon and Tano tracked him across the galaxy and brought him back Coruscant for justice. Windu confronted the boy briefly before he was marched off to prison, only to discover his hatred of the Jedi was as strong as ever.{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}} ====Savage Opress==== {{Dialogue|Obi-Wan Kenobi|Darth Maul? An [[Savage Opress/Legends|unknown assailant]] had slaughtered all the Republic soldiers including the [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]] Jedi Master [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] and his Padawan, the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Knox/Legends|Knox]]. Even the Separatist troops were all destroyed. [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] bought back the bodies for a Jedi funeral and several Jedi, including Obi-Wan Kenobi, Plo Koon and Adi Gallia inspected the bodies at a loss at who could have performed the murders.{{TCW|Monster}} Summoning Kenobi to meet with them, Windu and Yoda stated that they had recovered footage from Devaron of the massacre. The images showed a [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] brutally slaughter Master Halsey. Kenobi was baffled, for he was sure he had killed Darth Maul himself in Theed years before. Yoda said he was correct, but this creature, though from the same [[Species/Legends|species]], was from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], the planet of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. Windu said that Dathomir was the place that Maul was raised and [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] is were the men lived. Yoda then dispatched Kenobi to find this warrior and to deal with him. ====Capture of Even Piell==== {{Dialogue|Yoda|Of Master Piell's loss, we are sorry to hear.|Mace Windu|He will be missed.|Plo Koon|Because of his great sacrifice, we now have the Nexus Route coordinates.|attr=Yoda, Mace Windu and Plo Koon reflect on Even Piell's final mission|src={{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}}} [[File:CitadelDebrief-CR.png|thumb|left|250px|Debriefing after the rescue mission]] Sometime later, the Jedi High Council learned that Jedi Master and fellow councilor Even Piell had obtained secret [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordinates on the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]], which were of vital importance. Those coordinates could turn the tide of the war to the side that possessed them because the route went into the homeworlds of both the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}} Unfortunately, Piell was captured along with his men and captain [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]. Piell was then taken to the Separatist prison known as the [[The Citadel (episode)|Citadel]] on [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]]. Therefore, a [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|rescue mission]] was planned. Using old data from the Jedi Archives, Master Plo Koon planned the rescue in which Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, Captain Rex and Commander [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] would lead. In addition, Skywalker's Padawan, Ahsoka Tano. was initially refused to join, but she stowed away. Shortly afterwards, a message was sent to the Jedi Temple, and Windu along with Saesee Tiin and Yoda learned that the plan had changed due to a slight incident that had occurred. Windu quietly spoke with Yoda until Kenobi and Skywalker reported in and said that their transport had been destroyed and their rescue mission had dramatically changed for the worst. Shortly after, Piell contacted the Jedi and asked for reinforcements, which Koon assured him he would get.{{TCW|Counterattack}} Koon and his men rallied Tiin, Kit Fisto and Adi Gallia to his side and planned a rescue for the strike team. However, Piell died during the fighting at the hands of an [[Anooba/Legends|anooba]] beast before Koon arrived. He was [[Funeral of Even Piell/Legends|laid to rest]] in the lava rivers of the planet. The team was soon saved and taken back to the Jedi Temple for debriefing. The coordinates, in the hands of Tano and Tarkin, generated debate as Tarkin was instructed by Chancellor Palpatine to bring the information directly to him, while Tano argued that Master Piell had ordered her to deliver it to the Council only. Yoda said he would meet with the Chancellor and discuss it with him. Piell's Council seat would remain vacant until 19 BBY when Skywalker would be elected as Palpatine's representative. ====A lost Padawan==== Afterwards, Windu was at the Jedi Temple with Yoda, Anakin Skywalker, [[Finn Ertay/Legends|Finn Ertay]], [[Eekar Oki/Legends|Eekar Oki]] and Plo Koon when the bounty hunters [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]] and [[Seripas/Legends|Seripas]] arrived with a group of younglings in their ship, ''Halo'', that had been saved from [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] captivity on the moon of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]].
